title: X-Schema
description: Declarative specification for rendering and editing structured object values in XShell.

root.description: Name of the root object type declared in types. The referenced type must exist; this is enforced by X-Schema semantic validation.

types.description: Named reusable or recursive object type definitions.

element.description: Any element allowed in an object or container children collection.

data.description: An element representing a data value. Presentation-only containers are excluded.

type.description: Named reusable object editor structure. Presentation and behavior of the object occurrence itself belong on object elements that reference the type.

create.description: Default value used when creating an instance of this object type.

object.description: Object value. It is either defined inline with children or references a named type. When bind is omitted, it operates on the current data-context value.

type.description: Name of an object type declared in the top-level types registry. The referenced type must exist; this is enforced by X-Schema semantic validation.

bind.description: Path relative to the current data context. Scoped paths may use $current, $parent or $root. When a data element omits bind, it operates directly on the current data-context value.

required.description: Static required state. A conditions.required rule, when present, dynamically overrides this value.

create.description: Value used when creating an inline object.

field.description: Editable atomic value. When bind is omitted, the field edits the current data-context value itself.

bind.description: Path relative to the current data context. Scoped paths may use $current, $parent or $root. When a data element omits bind, it operates directly on the current data-context value.

required.description: Static required state. A conditions.required rule, when present, dynamically overrides this value.

dataType.description: Logical value type edited by a field.

default.description: Default value used when the field value has not otherwise been initialized.

source.description: Opaque source locator, such as $root.countries or datasource:countries.

key.description: Property containing the value stored by the field.

label.description: Property containing the human-readable label presented to the user.

array.description: Ordered collection of data values. When bind is omitted, the array operates on the current data-context value.

bind.description: Path relative to the current data context. Scoped paths may use $current, $parent or $root. When a data element omits bind, it operates directly on the current data-context value.

required.description: Static required state. A conditions.required rule, when present, dynamically overrides this value.

container.description: Presentation-only element used to compose child elements. Containers do not bind data and do not establish a new data context.

conditions.description: Dynamic presentation state. On containers, enabled and readonly apply to descendant editable elements.

required.description: Dynamically overrides the element's static required property.

pathCondition.description: Atomic condition evaluated against one path. Exactly one predicate must be specified.
